examples.chinese: 你的筆在那本書上面。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de bǐ zài nà běn shū shàngmiàn.
examples.english: Your pen is on top of the book.

examples.chinese: 沙發上面、下面跟旁邊都沒有。媽，妳幫我找，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: Shāfā shàngmiàn, xiàmiàn gēn pángbiān dōu méiyǒu. Mā, nǐ bāng wǒ zhǎo, hǎo ma?
examples.english: It is neither on the sofa, under the sofa, nor beside the sofa. Mom, could you find it for me?

examples.chinese: 客廳的桌子上有一個錢包，是不是你的？
examples.pinyin: Kètīng de zhuōzi shàng yǒu yí ge qiánbāo, shì bú shì nǐ de?
examples.english: In the living room, there is a wallet on the table. Is that yours?

examples.chinese: 哥哥喜歡在床上看書。
examples.pinyin: Gēge xǐhuān zài chuáng shàng kànshū.
examples.english: My elder brother likes to read in bed.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸每天早上都喝一杯咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba měi tiān zǎoshang dōu hē yì bēi kāfēi.
examples.english: My father drinks a cup of coffee every morning.

examples.chinese: 我今天晚上要去同學家玩。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān wǎnshang yào qù tóngxué jiā wán.
examples.english: I am going to hang out with my classmate at his/her place tonight.

examples.chinese: A：你今天早上有課嗎？ B：我今天早上沒有課。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ jīntiān zǎoshang yǒu kè ma? B: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang méi yǒu kè.
examples.english: A: Do you have class this morning? B: I don’t have class this morning.

examples.chinese: 謝謝！明天晚上六點來我家，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Xièxie! Míngtiān wǎnshang liù diǎn lái wǒ jiā, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: Thanks! How about coming to my place at 6 p.m. tomorrow?

examples.chinese: 我早上沒有課，九點去圖書館。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang méi yǒu kè, jiǔ diǎn qù túshūguǎn.
examples.english: I don’t have class in the morning. I am going to the library at 9:00.

examples.chinese: 你喜歡山上的風景還是海邊的風景？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuān shānshàng de fēngjǐng háishì hǎibiān de fēngjǐng?
examples.english: Do you like the scenery on the mountain or on the beach?

examples.chinese: 我常常在咖啡廳上網、看書。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng zài kāfēitīng shàngwǎng, kànshū.
examples.english: I often surf the internet and read at the café.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上七點去學校運動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang qī diǎn qù xuéxiào yùndòng.
examples.english: I go to school to exercise at 7:00 every morning.

examples.chinese: 我平常早上七點起床，八點吃早飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng, bā diǎn chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: I usually get up at seven and have breakfast at eight in the morning.

examples.chinese: 你不要常常在家上網、看電腦、玩手機，應該去運動。明天我有空，我們可以一起去騎腳踏車。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào chángcháng zài jiā shàngwǎng, kàn diànnǎo, wán shǒujī, yīnggāi qù yùndòng. Míngtiān wǒ yǒukòng, wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ qù qí jiǎotàchē.
examples.english: Don’t surf the internet, use the computer or play on the cell phone at home often. You should go exercise. I am available tomorrow. We can go ride bikes together.

examples.chinese: 我也不知道。我們可以先上網看地圖。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yě bù zhīdào. Wǒmen kěyǐ xiān shàngwǎng kàn dìtú.
examples.english: I don’t know either. We can check the map online first.

examples.chinese: 啊！上課了！我們先上課吧。
examples.pinyin: A! Shàngkè le! Wǒmen xiān shàngkè ba.
examples.english: Ah! The class has started! Let’s go to class now.

examples.chinese: 我平常坐紅線去學校上課，週末也坐捷運去運動、看電影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zuò hóng xiàn qù xuéxiào shàngkè, zhōumò yě zuò jiéyùn qù yùndòng, kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: I usually go to school by the red one. On weekends I take it to exercise or see a movie as well.

examples.chinese: 現在他在上書法課，我們四點去吧。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tā zài shàng shūfǎ kè, wǒmen sì diǎn qù ba.
examples.english: He is in the calligraphy class now. Let’s do it at 4 p.m.

examples.chinese: 可是從四點到五點半我要上英文課，六點去，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Kěshì cóng sì diǎn dào wǔ diǎn bàn wǒ yào shàng Yīngwén kè, liù diǎn qù, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: But I have an English class from 4 to 5:30 p.m. How about 6 p.m.?

examples.chinese: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 下個星期華語課有期中考，我有一點兒緊張，所以每天晚上都讀書，也練習寫字，希望下個星期的考試能考得很好。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí Huáyǔ kè yǒu qízhōngkǎo, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, yě liànxí xiězì, xīwàng xià ge xīngqí de kǎoshì néng kǎo de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: I will have the midterm exam for Chinese class next week. I am a bit nervous so I study every night and practice writing Chinese characters as well. I hope I can do well on the exam next week.

examples.chinese: 老師，國安今天要請假。他發燒了，不能來上課。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī, Guó'ān jīntiān yào qǐngjià. Tā fāshāo le, bù néng lái shàngkè.
examples.english: Teacher, Guoan has to take a leave today. He has a fever and he can’t come to school.

examples.chinese: 他打電話跟我說，他不能來上課，請我幫他請假。
examples.pinyin: Tā dǎ diànhuà gēn wǒ shuō, tā bù néng lái shàngkè, qǐng wǒ bāng tā qǐngjià.
examples.english: He gave me a call and told me that he couldn’t make it to class and asked me to ask for a leave for him.

examples.chinese: 他說他會去看醫生，請我們不要擔心，如果他好了，就會來學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā huì qù kàn yīshēng, qǐng wǒmen bú yào dānxīn, rúguǒ tā hǎo le, jiù huì lái xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: He said he will go see a doctor and he does not want to worry us. If he feels better, he will come to school.

examples.chinese: 我們都希望他明天能回學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu xīwàng tā míngtiān néng huí xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: We all hope he can come back to school tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 我們下個星期要學第十五課，我剛才先看了一點兒，書上有很多種動物，我覺得很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xià ge xīngqí yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, wǒ gāngcái xiān kàn le yìdiǎnr, shū shàng yǒu hěn duō zhǒng dòngwù, wǒ juéde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: We are going to learn lesson fifteen next week. I previewed a bit earlier just now. There are many kinds of animals in the book; I think it is very interesting.

examples.chinese: 很簡單，上網一查就知道了。
examples.pinyin: Hěn jiǎndān, shàngwǎng yì chá jiù zhīdào le.
examples.english: It’s very simple. You can know it as soon as you check it online.

examples.chinese: 好，我上網查查看。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ shàngwǎng cháchá kàn.
examples.english: OK, I will do that.

examples.chinese: 燈籠上的小老虎好可愛。
examples.pinyin: Dēnglóng shàng de xiǎo lǎohǔ hǎo kě'ài.
examples.english: The little tiger on the lantern is so lovely.

items.wordHook: 上(top) + 面(side) → the top side: 上面 means above.

examples.chinese: 可是我不知道怎麼走，妳知道嗎？
examples.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ bù zhīdào zěnme zǒu, nǐ zhīdào ma?
examples.english: But I don’t know how to get there, do you?

examples.chinese: 聽說那家飯店不遠，我想我們可以從學校走路去。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà jiā fàndiàn bù yuǎn, wǒ xiǎng wǒmen kěyǐ cóng xuéxiào zǒulù qù.
examples.english: I heard that the hotel is not far; I think we can go there from the school on foot.

examples.chinese: 我想走路去一定沒問題。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zǒulù qù yídìng méi wèntí.
examples.english: I think it will certainly be okay going there on foot.

examples.chinese: 可是我覺得那裡有點兒遠，走路去太累了。
examples.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ juéde nàlǐ yǒudiǎnr yuǎn, zǒulù qù tài lèi le.
examples.english: But I think it’s a bit far. It’s too tiring to get there on foot.

examples.chinese: 友美，妳看，天美飯店在大學路。我現在知道怎麼走了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi, nǐ kàn, Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài Dàxué Lù. Wǒ xiànzài zhīdào zěnme zǒu le.
examples.english: Look, Youmei. Tianmei Hotel is on Daxue Road. Now I know how to get there.

items.wordHook: The open 土(earth) under a 龰(foot) → off to 走(walk) now.

examples.chinese: 我週末還要工作，打算一下班就去看燈會。我們可以約友美一起去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò hái yào gōngzuò, dǎsuàn yí xiàbān jiù qù kàn dēnghuì. Wǒmen kěyǐ yuē Yǒuměi yìqǐ qù.
examples.english: I have to work on weekends, and plan to go to the Lantern Carnival as soon as I get off from work. We can ask Youmei out for the Lantern Carnival together.

examples.chinese: 現在坐捷運的人很多，我們需要排隊。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài zuò jiéyùn de rén hěn duō, wǒmen xūyào páiduì.
examples.english: There are many people taking the MRT now; we need to line up.

examples.chinese: 捷運站的洗手間外面有很多人在排隊，你要去嗎？
examples.pinyin: Jiéyùn zhàn de xǐshǒujiān wàimiàn yǒu hěn duō rén zài páiduì, nǐ yào qù ma?
examples.english: Outside the restroom at the MRT station there are many people lining up; do you want to go?

examples.chinese: 火車應該快到了，我們去前面排隊吧。
examples.pinyin: Huǒchē yīnggāi kuài dào le, wǒmen qù qiánmiàn páiduì ba.
examples.english: The train should be arriving soon; let's go line up in front.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"這本小說很有意思，值得推薦。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"雖然我排隊排了一個小時才買到跨年演唱會的票，可是很值得。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō hěn yǒu yìsi, zhídé tuījiàn. Suīrán wǒ páiduì pái le yí ge xiǎoshí cái mǎi dào kuànián yǎnchànghuì de piào, kěshì hěn zhídé.
examples.english: This novel is very interesting and worth recommending. Although I waited in line for an hour before I got tickets to the New Year's Eve concert, it was very worth it.

examples.chinese: 自從有了抽號機以後，人們就不需要站著排隊了。
你的臥室看起來真漂亮！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de wòshì kàn qǐlái zhēn piàoliang!
examples.english: Your bedroom looks really beautiful!

examples.chinese: 這個菜看起來很辣，其實不太辣。
examples.pinyin: Zhège cài kàn qǐlái hěn là, qíshí bù tài là.
examples.english: This dish looks very spicy, but in fact it's not very spicy.

examples.chinese: 媽媽煎了一條魚，又煮了蘿蔔湯，看起來都很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Māma jiān le yī tiáo yú, yòu zhǔ le luóbo tāng, kàn qǐlái dōu hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: Mom pan-fried a fish and also cooked radish soup; they both look delicious.

examples.chinese: 台北101大樓的樣子看起來就像竹子一樣節節高升。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi 101 dàlóu de yàngzi kàn qǐlái jiù xiàng zhúzi yíyàng jiéjié gāoshēng.
examples.english: The appearance of the Taipei 101 building looks just like bamboo, rising higher section by section.

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？看起來很不開心的樣子。 B:唉！工廠發生問題，今天又得加班處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Kàn qǐlái hěn bù kāixīn de yàngzi. B: Āi! Gōngchǎng fāshēng wèntí, jīntiān yòu děi jiābān chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: What's wrong? You look very unhappy. B: Alas! There's a problem at the factory; I have to work overtime again today to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 童先生穿著一件綠色的襯衫，配上一條咖啡色的褲子，看起來真像一棵樹。
examples.pinyin: Tóng xiānsheng chuānzhe yī jiàn lǜsè de chènshān, pèi shàng yī tiáo kāfēisè de kùzi, kàn qǐlái zhēn xiàng yī kē shù.
examples.english: Mr. Tong is wearing a green shirt, matched with a brown pair of pants; he really looks like a tree.

examples.chinese: 我們學校的禮堂看起來空間不大，其實坐得下一千人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào de lǐtáng kàn qǐlái kōngjiān bú dà, qíshí zuò de xià yì qiān rén.
examples.english: Our school's auditorium looks like it doesn't have much space, but actually it can seat a thousand people.

examples.chinese: 那個人看起來很神祕，大家都不知道他從哪裡來、做什麼工作。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge rén kàn qǐlái hěn shénmì, dàjiā dōu bù zhīdào tā cóng nǎlǐ lái, zuò shénme gōngzuò.
examples.english: That person looks very mysterious; everyone doesn't know where he comes from or what job he does.

examples.chinese: 那位服務生不笑的時候，樣子看起來很兇，其實他對客人的態度很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi fúwùshēng bù xiào de shíhou, yàngzi kàn qǐlái hěn xiōng, qíshí tā duì kèrén de tàidù hěn hǎo.
examples.english: When that waiter doesn't smile, he looks very fierce, but actually his attitude toward customers is very good.

examples.chinese: 小李今天看起來比較瘦，可能是因為穿了深色衣服的關係。我妹妹剛學會游泳，就想游到水很深的地方，我覺得太危險了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái bǐjiào shòu, kěnéng shì yīnwèi chuān le shēnsè yīfu de guānxi. Wǒ mèimei gāng xuéhuì yóuyǒng, jiù xiǎng yóu dào shuǐ hěn shēn de dìfāng, wǒ juéde tài wēixiǎn le.
examples.english: Xiao Li looks thinner today; it might be because he wore dark-colored clothes. My younger sister just learned to swim and already wants to swim to a place where the water is very deep; I think it's too dangerous.

examples.chinese: 金小姐穿上這件淺色的上衣， 看起來更年輕、更有精神了。這個衣櫃有點兒淺，這件厚大衣掛不進去，就算掛進去了， 門也關不起來。
examples.pinyin: Jīn xiǎojiě chuān shàng zhè jiàn qiǎnsè de shàngyī, kàn qǐlái gèng niánqīng, gèng yǒu jīngshén le. Zhège yīguì yǒudiǎnr qiǎn, zhè jiàn hòu dàyī guà bù jìnqù, jiùsuàn guà jìnqù le, mén yě guān bù qǐlái.
examples.english: When Miss Jin puts on this light-colored top, she looks younger and more energetic. This wardrobe is a bit shallow; this thick coat can't hang inside, and even if it could, the door wouldn't close.

examples.chinese: 我媽媽很會保養，看起來又年輕又漂亮，很多人都以為我們是姊妹。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma hěn huì bǎoyǎng, kàn qǐlái yòu niánqīng yòu piàoliang, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒmen shì jiěmèi.
examples.english: My mother is very good at taking care of herself; she looks both young and pretty, and many people think we are sisters.

examples.chinese: 小藍看起來糊里糊塗的，其實做起事來仔細得很。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎolán kàn qǐlái húlǐhútú de, qíshí zuò qǐ shì lái zǐxì de hěn.
examples.english: Xiaolan looks muddle-headed, but actually she is very careful when doing things.

examples.chinese: 顏太太很會保養，母子兩人站在一起時，看起來就像一對姊弟。
examples.pinyin: Yán tàitai hěn huì bǎoyǎng, mǔzǐ liǎng rén zhàn zài yīqǐ shí, kàn qǐlái jiù xiàng yī duì zǐdì.
examples.english: Mrs. Yan is very good at maintaining her appearance; when the mother and son stand together, they look like a pair of siblings.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡玻璃做的杯子，用起來比較安心，看起來也很漂亮。
彩色照片看起來很真實，不過黑白照片給人的感覺也很特別。
在天氣好的夜晚，星光看起來更加浪漫。
那位新郎的歲數比新娘大十五歲，可是兩人看起來一樣年輕。
有人覺得留鬍子比較帥，我倒是覺得留了鬍子看起來比較老。
這家工廠使用的大型機械全都是淺綠色的，看起來很有特色。
她在嬰兒車上安裝了一排不同顏色的小燈，看起來很特別。
沒想到利用春假出國旅行的人真不少！
examples.pinyin: Méi xiǎngdào lìyòng chūnjià chūguó lǚxíng de rén zhēn bùshǎo!
examples.english: I didn't expect that there are really quite a few people who take advantage of spring break to travel abroad!

examples.chinese: 我答應朋友去KTV幫他過生日，沒想到當天我太忙，忘了這件事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dāyìng péngyou qù KTV bāng tā guò shēngrì, méi xiǎngdào dāngtiān wǒ tài máng, wàng le zhè jiàn shì.
examples.english: I promised my friend to go to KTV to celebrate his birthday, but I didn't expect that I would be too busy that day and forgot about this matter.

examples.chinese: 那個明星很會演戲，演了幾年戲就開始當導演，沒想到第一部戲就成功了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge míngxīng hěn huì yǎnxì, yǎn le jǐ nián xì jiù kāishǐ dāng dǎoyǎn, méi xiǎngdào dì yī bù xì jiù chénggōng le.
examples.english: That star is very good at acting; after acting for a few years, he started being a director. Unexpectedly, his first film was a success.

examples.chinese: 沒想到我奶奶那個年代流行的衣服，現在又流行起來了。李小龍（Bruce Lee）是七○年 （qīlíng niándài，1970∼1979） 非常有名的功夫明星。
examples.pinyin: Méi xiǎngdào wǒ nǎinai nàge niándài liúxíng de yīfu, xiànzài yòu liúxíng qǐlái le. Lǐ Xiǎolóng (Bruce Lee) shì qīlíng niándài fēicháng yǒumíng de gōngfu míngxīng.
examples.english: I never thought that the clothes that were popular in my grandmother's era would become popular again now. Bruce Lee was a very famous martial arts star in the 1970s.

examples.chinese: 公司進了各式各樣的健身機器， 我們得好好利用這些機器，訓練自己的體力。美美剛進模特兒公司時，有一位導演找她演戲，沒想到就讓她變成了有名的明星。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jìn le gèshì-gèyàng de jiànshēn jīqì, wǒmen děi hǎohǎo lìyòng zhèxiē jīqì, xùnliàn zìjǐ de tǐlì. Měiměi gāng jìn mótè'ér gōngsī shí, yǒu yí wèi dǎoyǎn zhǎo tā yǎn xì, méi xiǎngdào jiù ràng tā biàn chéng le yǒumíng de míngxīng.
examples.english: The company purchased various kinds of fitness machines; we must make good use of these machines to train our physical strength. When Meimei first entered the modeling agency, a director asked her to act in a show; unexpectedly, it made her a famous star.

examples.chinese: 小元昨天剛買了一件八千元的大衣，沒想到那家服裝店今天打三折，他太吃虧了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoyuán zuótiān gāng mǎi le yī jiàn bāqiān yuán de dàyī, méi xiǎngdào nà jiā fúzhuāngdiàn jīntiān dǎ sān zhé, tā tài chīkuī le.
examples.english: Xiaoyuan just bought an 8,000-yuan coat yesterday; unexpectedly, that clothing store is having a 70% off sale today—he really suffered a loss.

examples.chinese: 剛才我正想給英英打電話時，沒想到她就先打來了。
examples.pinyin: Gāngcái wǒ zhèng xiǎng gěi Yīngying dǎ diànhuà shí, méi xiǎngdào tā jiù xiān dǎ lái le.
examples.english: Just now, when I was right about to call Yingying, I didn't expect that she would call first.

examples.chinese: 張先生以為喝醉了就能把痛苦忘掉，沒想到越喝越痛苦。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng yǐwéi hē zuì le jiù néng bǎ tòngkǔ wàng diào, méi xiǎngdào yuè hē yuè tòngkǔ.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang thought that getting drunk would let him forget his pain, but unexpectedly, the more he drank, the more painful he felt.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友昨天去河邊露營， 我們試著在河裡抓魚，沒想到真的抓到了五條魚。金先生親眼見過警察在街上抓小偷，一個跑來跑去，一個追來追去，他覺得太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyǒu zuótiān qù hébiān lùyíng, wǒmen shìzhe zài hé lǐ zhuā yú, méi xiǎngdào zhēn de zhuā dào le wǔ tiáo yú. Jīn xiānsheng qīnyǎn jiàn guò jǐngchá zài jiē shàng zhuā xiǎotōu, yī ge pǎo lái pǎo qù, yī ge zhuī lái zhuī qù, tā juéde tài cìjī le.
examples.english: My friend and I went camping by the river yesterday; we tried to catch fish in the river, and unexpectedly, we really caught five fish. Mr. Jin has seen with his own eyes the police catching a thief on the street—one running back and forth, the other chasing back and forth—he thought it was too exciting.

examples.chinese: 我記得第一次出國讀書時，因為不習慣和家人分開，常常半夜哭著打電話回家。那對情侶因為不了解而在一起，沒想到最後因為了解而分開。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìde dì yī cì chūguó dúshū shí, yīnwèi bù xíguàn hé jiārén fēnkāi, chángcháng bànyè kūzhe dǎ diànhuà huí jiā. Nà duì qínglǚ yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér zài yīqǐ, méi xiǎngdào zuìhòu yīnwèi liǎojiě ér fēnkāi.
examples.english: I remember when I first went abroad to study, because I wasn't used to being separated from my family, I often cried on the phone at midnight. That couple got together because they didn't understand each other, but unexpectedly in the end they separated because they understood each other.

examples.chinese: 陳先生身體一向挺健康的，沒想到一個小感冒就讓他病了一個多月。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiānshēng shēntǐ yīxiàng tǐng jiànkāng de, méi xiǎngdào yī gè xiǎo gǎnmào jiù ràng tā bìng le yī gè duō yuè.
examples.english: Mr. Chen has always been quite healthy; I never expected that a small cold would make him fall ill for over a month.

examples.chinese: 我的法國朋友最初只計畫來臺灣學中文，沒想到後來拿到了獎學金，還念了博士班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Fǎguó péngyǒu zuìchū zhǐ jìhuà lái Táiwān xué Zhōngwén, méi xiǎngdào hòulái nádàole jiǎngxuéjīn, hái niànle bóshìbān.
examples.english: At first, my French friend only planned to come to Taiwan to study Chinese; unexpectedly, later he received a scholarship and even studied in a doctoral program.

examples.chinese: 結婚之前，那對情侶認真規劃了未來的生活，沒想到結婚一個月之後就離婚了。
examples.pinyin: Jiéhūn zhīqián, nà duì qínglǚ rènzhēn guīhuà le wèilái de shēnghuó, méi xiǎngdào jiéhūn yí ge yuè zhīhòu jiù líhūn le.
examples.english: Before getting married, that couple carefully planned their future life; unexpectedly, they divorced just one month after getting married.

examples.chinese: 他以前化學成績常不及格，沒想到現在卻是有名的化學教授。
以往在冬天才開的花，沒想到夏天就開了，大家都覺得很意外。
王先生上週向他女友求婚，沒想到才過了幾天就訂婚了。
這個背包在設計上沒什麼特色，只是印了某位明星隨手畫的圖，沒想到就要賣上萬元，實在有點兒誇張。
孩子是父母最珍貴的寶貝，父母對他們的愛也是最真實的。小文房內的櫃子裡擺了很多寶貝，都是他上山下海帶回來的紀念品。
examples.pinyin: 1. Háizi shì fùmǔ zuì zhēnguì de bǎobèi, fùmǔ duì tāmen de ài yě shì zuì zhēnshí de. 2. Xiǎo Wén fángnèi de guìzi lǐ bǎi le hěn duō bǎobèi, dōu shì tā shàngshān xiàhǎi dài huílái de jìniànpǐn.
examples.english: 1. Children are their parents' most precious treasures, and parents' love for them is also the most genuine. 2. In the cabinet in Little Wen's room, there are many treasures displayed, all souvenirs he brought back from climbing mountains and exploring the seas.

examples.chinese: 孩子是父母最親愛的寶貝，父母對他們的愛是沒辦法用文字來形容的。
examples.pinyin: Háizi shì fùmǔ zuì qīn'ài de bǎobèi, fùmǔ duì tāmen de ài shì méi bànfǎ yòng wénzì lái xíngróng de.
examples.english: Children are their parents' most beloved treasures; parents' love for them cannot be described in words.

items.wordHook: Combining 寶(treasure) and 貝(sea shell): 寶貝 means treasured object, treasure.

examples.chinese: 今天天氣不錯，我們去海邊曬太陽吧。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì búcuò, wǒmen qù hǎibiān shài tàiyáng ba.
examples.english: The weather is nice today. Let’s go to the beach to get some sun!

examples.chinese: 這本書很不錯。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū hěn búcuò.
examples.english: This book is not bad.

examples.chinese: 國安跟我說，他今天要去看醫生，他家附近有一家不錯的醫院。
examples.pinyin: Guó'ān gēn wǒ shuō, tā jīntiān yào qù kàn yīshēng, tā jiā fùjìn yǒu yì jiā búcuò de yīyuàn.
examples.english: Guoan told me he is going to see a doctor today; there is a nice hospital near his place.

examples.chinese: 我覺得有的舊東西很不錯，有的新東西也很有趣，我很喜歡看新車、新衣服，可是因為我的錢不多，所以我不常買。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒude jiù dōngxi hěn búcuò, yǒude xīn dōngxi yě hěn yǒuqù, wǒ hěn xǐhuān kàn xīn chē, xīn yīfu, kěshì yīnwèi wǒ de qián bù duō, suǒyǐ wǒ bù cháng mǎi.
examples.english: I think some old stuff is good and some new ones are interesting. I like to check the new car, new clothes out, but I do not have much money, so I don’t buy them often.

examples.chinese: 妳看，這條黃色的褲子不錯吧？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, zhè tiáo huángsè de kùzi búcuò ba?
examples.english: Look! This pair of yellow pants is nice, isn’t it?

examples.chinese: 今天天氣不錯，海邊的風景也很漂亮，我想去游泳，妳們想去嗎？
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì búcuò, hǎibiān de fēngjǐng yě hěn piàoliàng, wǒ xiǎng qù yóuyǒng, nǐmen xiǎng qù ma?
examples.english: The weather is pretty good today, so is the view at the beach. I want to go swimming. Do you want to go?

examples.chinese: 我知道一家很不錯的咖啡廳，那裡的冰淇淋很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào yì jiā hěn búcuò de kāfēitīng, nàlǐ de bīngqílín hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: I know a nice café. They serve delicious ice cream.

items.wordHook: a 金(gold) coin takes a 昔(past) stamp upside down → 錯(wrong).

examples.chinese: 在華人社會中，「龍」具有重要的文化意義，但「龍」其實是不存在的。
examples.pinyin: Zài Huárén shèhuì zhōng, "lóng" jùyǒu zhòngyào de wénhuà yìyì, dàn "lóng" qíshí shì bù cúnzài de.
examples.english: In Chinese society, the "dragon" has important cultural significance, but the "dragon" actually does not exist.

examples.chinese: 幸虧你來幫忙，要不然我一個人絕對忙不過來。幸虧我把資料都存在雲端，要不然找不到隨身碟，怎麼開會呢？
examples.pinyin: 1. Xìngkuī nǐ lái bāngmáng, yàobùrán wǒ yí ge rén juéduì máng bú guòlái. 2. Xìngkuī wǒ bǎ zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, yàobùrán zhǎo bú dào suíshēndié, zěnme kāihuì ne?
examples.english: 1. Thanks to your help, otherwise I definitely wouldn't be able to handle it alone. 2. Fortunately, I saved all the data in the cloud; otherwise, if I couldn't find the USB drive, how could we have the meeting?

examples.chinese: 我沒趕上最後一班公車，這下子只好搭計程車回家了。A:糟了，我不小心把隨身碟弄丟了，資料都存在裡面。 B:這下子我們的期末報告都白做了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi gǎnshàng zuìhòu yī bān gōngchē, zhè xiàzi zhǐhǎo dā jìchéngchē huí jiā le. A: Zāo le, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn bǎ suíshēndié nòng diū le, zīliào dōu cún zài lǐmiàn. B: Zhè xiàzi wǒmen de qīmò bàogào dōu bái zuò le.
examples.english: I didn't catch the last bus; now I have no choice but to take a taxi home. A: Oh no, I accidentally lost my USB drive; all the data is stored in it. B: Now all our final report work has been done in vain.

examples.chinese: 公司的會議資料都存在雲端，這樣又安全又方便，各部門也能隨時參考。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de huìyì zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, zhèyàng yòu ānquán yòu fāngbiàn, gè bùmén yě néng suíshí cānkǎo.
examples.english: The company's meeting materials are all stored in the cloud; this way it is both safe and convenient, and each department can also refer to them at any time.

examples.chinese: 我覺得把錢存在銀行比放在家裡安全多了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde bǎ qián cún zài yínháng bǐ fàng zài jiā lǐ ānquán duō le.
examples.english: I think saving money in the bank is much safer than keeping it at home.

examples.chinese: 上帝是不是存在，這是屬於宗教領域的問題，科學家的解釋不一定是正確的。
examples.pinyin: Shàngdì shì bú shì cúnzài, zhè shì shǔyú zōngjiào lǐngyù de wèntí, kēxuéjiā de jiěshì bù yídìng shì zhèngquè de.
examples.english: Whether God exists or not is a question that belongs to the religious field; scientists' explanations are not necessarily correct.

examples.chinese: 到底上帝存在不存在，科學與宗教的觀點不同，說法也不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Dàodǐ Shàngdì cúnzài bù cúnzài, kēxué yǔ zōngjiào de guāndiǎn bùtóng, shuōfǎ yě bù yīyàng.
examples.english: Whether God exists or not, the viewpoints of science and religion are different, and their explanations are also different.

examples.chinese: 假如擔心弄丟重要的資料，可複製一份存在電腦裡。

items.wordHook: Combining 存(exist) and 在(at): 存在 means exist.

examples.chinese: 那位服裝設計師相當喜愛十八世紀時的歐洲傳統風格。
許多世紀以來，受壓迫的民族都渴望擁有平等的待遇。
A:喲，你今天怎麼穿得這麼帥？ B:下午要參加公司茶會，得穿得正式一些？ A:那下次跟我約會時，也要這麼穿呦！
哎喲，已經半夜一點多了！我們就別再加班寫產品計畫了，等明天再繼續吧！
離我家不遠的劇院，是請著名設計師來設計的。
對自己的事業很熱情的人，就不怕挑戰任何困難。
能得到觀眾熱情掌聲的表演，才算是有魅力的表演。
那個農村裡有個小農場，他們生產的鮮奶冰淇淋非常好吃。
他放下工作回家鄉的理由，是因為家裡的農場無人照顧。
根據手術的種類，病人在動手術前能吃的食物也不太相同。
錢小姐戴的那副耳環就像星光一樣美麗，聽說那是祖母留給她的回憶。
這次文學比賽，我參加的項目是作文。
一開始奧運僅安排男子比賽項目，後來才有女子項目的比賽。

items.wordHook: A structured 制(system) governing regulations under standard 度(degree): 制度 means system, institution.
Raising a busy 扌(hand) to tackle a stack of chores piled 高(tall) gets things done to 搞(do).
a 𠂉(lying person) holds 卌(forty) ribbons and 一(one) steady beat as 舛(crossed feet) cross → the 舞(dance).
Combining 蔬(vegetables) and 菜(vegetables): 蔬菜 means vegetable s.
雜(various) + 誌(record) → a record of various things: a magazine.
高(high) + 興(mood) → high spirits, so 高興 means happy.
